note: CellRank fate probability and the committor both estimate probability of reaching Beta; scored on how well each recovers developmental stage. On this clean lineage PC1 edges out both, and the committor is competitive with (slightly ahead of) CellRank. This pipeline additionally provides the entropy-production test and kT barrier that CellRank does not compute. Running CellRank here needs the numpy-2 compat shim and n_jobs=1 included in the script.
